No CLAUDE.md or project docs beyond the stock Vite README — owner, hosting, and status are undocumented in-repo.

The Supabase 'dossier_submissions' table is a store of player facts captured OUTSIDE the registry write door. Per the SV Way validation-gate model this is a source adapter — but there is no evidence anything routes submissions into sv-registry _candidates. Read-duty/one-write-door gap, recorded honestly.
Upstream/downstream unknown: which system consumes dossier_submissions, and whether players entered here are resolved against Stadium-Ventures/sv-registry canon, is not determinable from this repo.
